question.text: Categories of investors recognised for Indian tax purposes include ALL EXCEPT:

answer.text: Non-individuals such as firms, companies, trusts, and AOPs
Portfolio managers acting as service providers

explanation.text: The Logic: For PMS tax purposes, recognised investor categories include resident individuals, NRIs, HUF, and non-individuals such as firms, companies, trusts, and AOPs. Portfolio managers are service providers running the portfolio — they are not themselves an investor category for tax classification. The Trap: Resident individuals/NRIs, HUF, and non-individual entities (firms, companies, trusts, AOPs) are all explicitly investor categories in the source, so none of those can be the exception. Note: Replaced the unserious "Mythical creatures" distractor with a plausible non-investor option (portfolio managers as service providers).
